title: Two Git ignore files nobody told me about
summary: A concise blog post revealing two lesser-known Git ignore mechanisms that most developers aren't aware of, helping them better manage which files should not be tracked in their repositories.
problem_solved: Addresses the lack of awareness about alternative Git ignore methods beyond the standard .gitignore file.
why_valuable: Provides practical tips for developers to manage repository exclusions locally without affecting the shared .gitignore configuration.
